verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the founder's HN comment that Shortwave's Gmail API integration enables "offline handling." No first-party docs explain what works offline or how changes sync on reconnect. missing for 10: documented offline reading, offline search, offline composing/drafting, reconnect sync/conflict behavior, per-platform offline support, first-party docs and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect

citations.quote: We integrate with Gmail's APIs (not IMAP) to enable faster real-time updates, better latency compensation, offline handling
